### YMCA turns crisis into capability at scale

YMCA partnered with Accenture to build a community-based model that helps refugees and displaced
people gain skills, find work, and rebuild their futures—moving from relief to long-term capability.

[
Read more
][135]

### How UNICEF's GenU is closing the youth skills gap

Through UNICEF’s partnership with Accenture, young people gain access to AI-powered skilling,
digital learning and entrepreneurship opportunities that connect them to employment and brighter
futures.

[
Read more
][136]

### Philipstown's wire cars go global

Philipstown’s wire car tradition is accelerating onto the global stage through immersive
storytelling, gaming and commerce—fueling opportunity and driving impact far beyond the track.

[
Read more
][137]

### Google Cloud reimagines lead enrichment with agentic AI

The leading hyperscaler replaced batch processing with an agentic model that delivers decision-ready
outputs up to 30x faster—sharpening prioritization while enabling more confident sales decisions.

### Bristol Myers Squibb scales AI to rewire everyday work

The life sciences leader is putting people at the center of its AI ambition—rewiring work across the
enterprise to empower employees, drive innovation and accelerate the delivery of therapies to
patients.

What Vuzix Does

## Waveguide optics and enterprise smart glasses

With 30 years in wearable technology, Vuzix develops waveguide optics for device makers and builds
smart glasses for enterprise use.

OEM & Waveguide Technology

### Optical platforms for device makers

Vuzix designs and manufactures waveguide optics, display systems, and OEM platforms for companies
building or white-labeling smart glasses.

# Battery-Powered
# Edge AI

Ambiq makes unprecedented energy-efficient SoCs and ultra-low power platform solutions that enable
edge AI on billions of battery-powered devices. Our mission is to put intelligence everywhere by
delivering the lowest-power semiconductor solutions on the planet. With the SPOT® platform and the
Apollo and Atomiq SoC family, Ambiq empowers innovators to build smarter, longer-lasting wearables,
IoT, smart home, healthcare, and industrial devices.

## [What is Edge AI? ][206]

Edge artificial intelligence (AI) refers to the deployment of AI models and algorithms directly on
power-constrained local devices at the edge, rather than in a centralized cloud environment.

[
More Info ][207]

While cloud-based AI platforms like ChatGPT have captured the spotlight since 2022, a quieter but
equally transformative revolution has been unfolding —Edge AI. As devices become more advanced and
versatile, AI must evolve beyond cloud-based implementations to thrive in environments where
computing and energy resources are limited.

## No need for an app.


An AR Code is a type of QR Code that contains the necessary information to generate an Augmented
Reality 3D experience. It operates without the need for a dedicated app on smartphones and AR/VR
headsets like the Apple Vision Pro. Begin creating, managing, and tracking your AR experiences.
[[AR QR Code]][39]


[Get Started][40] [Choose Your Plan][41]

Launch your first AR QR Code experience today.

[[F1 AR QR Code]][42] [[Piston AR QR Code]][43] [[Woman AR QR Code]][44] [[Statue museum AR QR
Code]][45] [[Trex AR QR Code]][46]


## [How to Scan an AR Code?][47]


**An AR Code is designed to be universally rendered without any app on all mobile devices, including
AR/VR headsets.** Immersive AR rendering is supported on iOS, Android OS, visionOS, and Meta Horizon
OS. Even older Android devices will have access to immersive WebAR thanks to our low-power SLAM
rendering technology. Additionally, AR Codes support advanced AR and AI features through our
solutions such as AR Face Filters and AI Codes, enhancing AR experiences across a wide range of
compatible smartphone devices.


[Create Your First AR Code][48]

Fast launch, broad compatibility, and no dedicated app to install.

AR Code technology has the potential to enhance a wide variety of products and materials. By using
AR QR Codes, businesses and organizations can easily add interactive, digital experiences to these
materials, making them more engaging and informative for users.

Integrate AR Codes on packaging for Augmented Reality digital experiences, easily scanned on Android
and iOS devices.

Add ARCodes on websites and e-commerce sites for engaging 3D product information or AR Videos.

[[AR Code Websites]][52]

Incorporate AR Codes on signage for interactive content such as product demos and event schedules.

[[AR Code Banners Posters]][54]

### [Flyers & Brochures][55]

Integrate AR Codes for interactive promotions and [Augmented Reality displays in restaurant
menus][56].

[[AR Code Brochures Flyers]][57]

### [Business Cards][58]

Utilize ARCodes on business cards for quick access to contact information or product details in 3D.

[[AR Code Business Cards]][59]

### [Books, Guides & Magazines][60]

Include AR QR Codes in publications for interactive content such as AR videos or AR 3D models.

[[AR Code Books]][61]

### Three types of AR rendering

AR Codes can be used to access different types of Augmented Reality rendering, including Immersive
AR, Face Filters AR and AI Assistance AR.

[[immersive AR rendering]][64] [[AR Face Filters]][65] [[AI Code]][66]

## **Immersive AR, Face Filters & AI Experiences**



* Immersive AR: displays AR experiences in your direct environment: 3D models, videos,
  photogrammetric 3D scans,...
  
  
* Face Filters AR: Displays AR Face filters created on the AR Code platform featuring your own image
  or logo.
  
  
* AI Experiences: [AI Code][67]; prompts users to take a photo, which is then analyzed by AI to
  provide personalized responses or advice, creating an individualized augmented reality experience.

**Augmented Reality Codes offer a wide range of possibilities for businesses, organizations, and
individuals to create and share interactive, digital experiences.**

Some potential uses for AR QR Codes include:
* Enhancing product packaging, signage, and other materials with interactive, [3D digital
  content][68].
* Creating immersive, interactive AR experiences for customers or users, such as virtual tours or
  product demonstrations.
* Providing information and instructions in Augmented Reality.
* Adding AR to games and other entertainment experiences.
* Creating AR marketing campaigns that attract attention and drive engagement.


By using AR Codes, it’s possible to create distinctive and captivating experiences that can enhance
a wide range of products, services, and materials. The concept of accessing augmented reality
content is gaining popularity, especially with the recent launch of the Apple Vision Pro headset.

We’ve completely redesigned our payments solution to help you get paid—faster.

[Get started][32]

Questions? Speak to a human.

Questions? Speak to a human.

[Call 1-888-323-4289][33]

## Smart for businesses, smart for partners

With new features like easy onboarding and built-in fraud prevention, we’ve reimagined Authorize.net
to help you get paid fast. See what’s new for businesses and partners.

[For businesses][34]

[For partners][35]

## See how we’ve reimagined Authorize.net

### New features, built for speed

Get paid faster with customizable dashboards, smart AI support, and built-in fraud prevention—all
powered by Visa’s payments ecosystem.

### Take, request, and find payments

Get set up fast with a seamless, intuitive payment experience.

### Not sure about something? Ask Anet

Get the answers you need, fast, with our new AI support tool, Ask Anet.

### Workspaces that stay connected

Stay connected across tools, teams, and transactions—backed by Visa.

### Tools to stop fraud fast

Protect every payment with built-in, real-time fraud detection.

[Demo for businesses][36]

[Demo for partners][37]

## Make payments a growth engine for your business

#### Online payments

Offer flexible online payments with credit cards, debit cards, eChecks, and major digital wallets
like Apple Pay, Google Pay, and PayPal for secure, convenient checkout.

[ [Learn more about online payments] ][38]

#### Smartphone payments

Accept secure mobile payments with smartphones, supporting QR codes, digital wallets, and fast
tap‑to‑pay options for easy checkout.

[ [Learn more about mobile payments] ][39]

#### In person with a card reader

Use Virtual Point of Sale to connect a card reader to your computer, sign in, and accept reliable
in‑person payments quickly and securely.

[ [Learn more about Virtual Point of Sale] ][40]

#### Over the phone

Process phone orders securely by entering customer details in the Virtual Terminal, allowing quick
manual payments through any web browser.

#### eCheck

Enable simple eCheck payments for recurring billing, invoices, and contactless transactions,
offering a low‑cost, dependable digital alternative.

#### Simple Checkout

Add Buy Now or Donate buttons to your site for fast checkout, ideal for nonprofits and merchants
selling single items or low‑volume products.

[ [Learn more about Simple Checkout] ][41]

Get free support from real people, 24/7.

Our state-of-the-art technology blends the tangible world with virtual augmentations, facilitating
precise measurements and seamless 3D model visualizations of complex steel assembly structures.

Embrace the power of augmented reality and unlock limitless possibilities within structural steel
fabrication. FabStation integrates smoothly with popular detailing software such as Tekla, SDS2,
Advanced Steel, SolidWorks, and Inventor, providing you with accurate steel fabrication solutions.

With Hololight's XR pixel-streaming technology, the headset only acts as a display, while all
processing stays on your workstation. This allows you to work with complex 3D models smoothly across
all major AR and VR devices.

Hololight Hub is your central XR streaming platform to deploy and manage all streamed applications
in one place. Add both in-house developed XR apps and third-party apps to your catalog, assign
access to users, and let them launch the apps from their account with one click.

Hololight provides a fully integrated 3D Viewer that lets you visualize your 3D models at 1:1 scale
and original complexity without time consuming data preparation.

## OUR MISSION
## Enterprise XR Infrastructure Built to Last

Hololight operates from a belief that XR will only reach its potential in enterprise when the
infrastructure beneath it is treated with the same seriousness as any other IT layer. That means
building for **durability** over novelty, **security by default** rather than as an afterthought,
and genuine **device independence** rather than vendor lock-in. The company takes a long view,
making architectural decisions based on where the market needs to go rather than what is easiest
today.

## FAQ
## XR and VR Streaming Basics for Enterprises
* [
  
  #### What is XR (Extended Reality)?
  
  ][77]
  
  **Extended Reality (XR)** is an umbrella term for immersive technologies such as **Virtual Reality
  (VR)**, **Augmented Reality (AR)**, and **Mixed Reality (MR)**. The goal is to merge digital
  content with the real world or to create entirely virtual environments.
* [
  
  #### What is VR (Virtual Reality)?
  
  ][78]
  
  **Virtual Reality (VR)** places users in a completely digital environment. With specialized VR
  headsets such as the **HTC Vive**, **Meta Quest 3**, or **PICO** devices, users can immerse
  themselves in virtual worlds that fully replace the real world.
* [
  
  #### What is AR (Augmented Reality)?
  
  ][79]
  
  **Augmented Reality (AR)** enhances the real world with digital content that is overlaid in real
  time. Well-known examples include the **Microsoft HoloLens** or AR features on modern smartphones.
* [
  
  #### What is VR streaming in an enterprise context?
  
  ][80]
  
  VR streaming refers to rendering VR applications on external infrastructure (cloud or servers) and
  sending the resulting high-quality visuals to headsets over a network.
  
  In enterprise XR deployments this supports larger models, consistent performance, and secure
  centralized control while reducing device constraints.
  
  
  [Learn more about Hololight's XR Streaming Technology][81]
* [
  
  #### Why do AR and VR apps need streaming?
  
  ][82]
  
  AR/VR streaming lets you run 3D applications on powerful external hardware instead of relying on
  the limited performance power of a headset.
  
  In essence, the device only acts as a screen, as all heavy processing happens in your controlled
  environment, and only pixels are sent to the device. This means you can use complex models without
  data preparation, keep sensitive information off the device, support all major AR/VR headsets, and
  scale XR across your organization with consistent performance and easier IT management.
  
  
  [Learn more about Hololight's XR Streaming Technology][83]
* [
  
  #### How does Hololight enable AR and VR streaming?
  
  ][84]
  Hololight uses its proprietary streaming technology to pixel-stream AR and VR applications from
  external hardware to all major AR and VR headsets.
  As the core pillar of your enterprise XR strategy, this approach makes deployments device-agnostic
  and future-proof, while keeping sensitive data secure by ensuring only images are streamed and
  application data remains within controlled infrastructure.
  
   
  
  [Learn more about Hololight's XR Streaming Technology][85]
* [
  
  #### Which headsets are available?
  
  ][86]
  
  There is a wide variety of AR/VR headsets on the market today, designed for different use cases,
  and new ones are continuously being released. Here is a selection of currently available XR
  devices, all of which are supported by our [streaming technology][87]:
  * **Meta Quest family** – with passthrough functionality to view digital content in the real
    world.
  * **PICO 4 Ultra **– VR headset for enterprises and consumers.
  * **HTC Vive family **– powerful VR headsets for gaming and enterprise applications.
  * **Microsoft HoloLens 2 **– headset for AR scenarios.
  * **Apple Vision Pro** – high-end headset with AR and VR support.

## OUR MISSION
## Enterprise XR Infrastructure Built to Last

Hololight operates from a belief that XR will only reach its potential in enterprise when the
infrastructure beneath it is treated with the same seriousness as any other IT layer. That means
building for **durability** over novelty, **security by default** rather than as an afterthought,
and genuine **device independence** rather than vendor lock-in. The company takes a long view,
making architectural decisions based on where the market needs to go rather than what is easiest
today.

## FAQ
## XR and VR Streaming Basics for Enterprises
* [
  
  #### What is XR (Extended Reality)?
  
  ][77]
  
  **Extended Reality (XR)** is an umbrella term for immersive technologies such as **Virtual Reality
  (VR)**, **Augmented Reality (AR)**, and **Mixed Reality (MR)**. The goal is to merge digital
  content with the real world or to create entirely virtual environments.
* [
  
  #### What is VR (Virtual Reality)?
  
  ][78]
  
  **Virtual Reality (VR)** places users in a completely digital environment. With specialized VR
  headsets such as the **HTC Vive**, **Meta Quest 3**, or **PICO** devices, users can immerse
  themselves in virtual worlds that fully replace the real world.
* [
  
  #### What is AR (Augmented Reality)?
  
  ][79]
  
  **Augmented Reality (AR)** enhances the real world with digital content that is overlaid in real
  time. Well-known examples include the **Microsoft HoloLens** or AR features on modern smartphones.
* [
  
  #### What is VR streaming in an enterprise context?
  
  ][80]
  
  VR streaming refers to rendering VR applications on external infrastructure (cloud or servers) and
  sending the resulting high-quality visuals to headsets over a network.
  
  In enterprise XR deployments this supports larger models, consistent performance, and secure
  centralized control while reducing device constraints.
  
  
  [Learn more about Hololight's XR Streaming Technology][81]
* [
  
  #### Why do AR and VR apps need streaming?
  
  ][82]
  
  AR/VR streaming lets you run 3D applications on powerful external hardware instead of relying on
  the limited performance power of a headset.
  
  In essence, the device only acts as a screen, as all heavy processing happens in your controlled
  environment, and only pixels are sent to the device. This means you can use complex models without
  data preparation, keep sensitive information off the device, support all major AR/VR headsets, and
  scale XR across your organization with consistent performance and easier IT management.
  
  
  [Learn more about Hololight's XR Streaming Technology][83]
* [
  
  #### How does Hololight enable AR and VR streaming?
  
  ][84]
  Hololight uses its proprietary streaming technology to pixel-stream AR and VR applications from
  external hardware to all major AR and VR headsets.
  As the core pillar of your enterprise XR strategy, this approach makes deployments device-agnostic
  and future-proof, while keeping sensitive data secure by ensuring only images are streamed and
  application data remains within controlled infrastructure.
  
   
  
  [Learn more about Hololight's XR Streaming Technology][85]
* [
  
  #### Which headsets are available?
  
  ][86]
  
  There is a wide variety of AR/VR headsets on the market today, designed for different use cases,
  and new ones are continuously being released. Here is a selection of currently available XR
  devices, all of which are supported by our [streaming technology][87]:
  * **Meta Quest family** – with passthrough functionality to view digital content in the real
    world.
  * **PICO 4 Ultra **– VR headset for enterprises and consumers.
  * **HTC Vive family **– powerful VR headsets for gaming and enterprise applications.
  * **Microsoft HoloLens 2 **– headset for AR scenarios.
  * **Apple Vision Pro** – high-end headset with AR and VR support.

## FAQ (For B2B Buyers)

Q 1: What’s the MOQ? Can I mix different acetate/metal/lens color?

A: In-stock MOQ is 12 pcs per color. Custom MOQ is usually 300–1000 pcs per model, depending on
material and design.

Q 2: If I have my thoughts, do you have a person to design according to my concept?

A: Yes, our design team is willing to do it for you.

Q 3: When do you ship my order?

A: Normally60-75 days after receiving your payments, but it’s according to your order QTY and
production schedule

Q 4: How can you guarantee production quality?

 A: We have a strictly quality control system in our production process, including raw material
QC,semi-finished product QC, finished product QC, all process QC,4 times inspection before package.
The third inspection is acceptable

Q 5: Do you provide sampels, how can I test your quality?

We have many model ready stock samples for your choice, pls contact us to choose the samples you
like.

Q 6 :What is your lead time for sampling and mass production?

A: Sampling is 5–30 days. Mass production is 30–90 days, depending on order complexity and capacity
schedule.

Q 7 :What product categories do you specialize in?

A:We focus on sunglasses, optical frames, and blue light glasses for brands, chains, and
distributors.

Q 8 :What logo methods do you offer?

A: Laser engraving, metal logo inlay, silk Printing /UV printing, and inside temple branding.

Q 9 :Can you do custom lenses?

A : Yes. Polarized, photochromic, AR coating, mirror/gradient tint, and UV400 options are available.

Q 10 :Can you help with custom colors and finishing?

A: Yes. We support custom acetate colors, two-tone lamination, matte/gloss finishing, and plating
colors for metal frames.

Q 11 :Do you offer custom packaging?

A: Yes. Cases, pouches, boxes, cleaning cloths, hang tags, barcode labels, and instruction/warranty
cards.

Q 12 : What certifications do you have?

A : We support CE, UKCA, FDA, ISO, and BSCI. Compliance documents can be shared during the RFQ
process.

Q 13 :How do you control quality?

A : We follow a QC checklist from incoming materials to final inspection and packing verification to
keep fit and finishing stable.

Q14 : What info do you need to quote quickly?

A: Category, material, lens option, logo method, target market, quantity, and your target price
range (if available).

## - About Joysee Optical -

Joysee Eyewear is a reputable **glasses & sunglasses manufacturer** established in **2016** in
**Wenzhou, China**.

We produce **glasses, sunglasses, optical frames, reading glasses, and blue light blocking glasses**
for brands, wholesalers, distributors, and importers.

Our factory commonly works with **acetate, metal, TR90, titanium, and wood** and supports **OEM,
ODM, private label, stock wholesale, sampling, and bulk production**.

For stock wholesale programs, MOQ can start from **12 pcs per color**. For custom development, the
usual MOQ is **300-600 pcs per model**, often with **2-3 colors**, depending on the style and
decoration plan.

Typical sample lead time is **5-30 days** and bulk production is usually **15-60 days**, depending
on material, order volume, and logo or packaging requirements.

We export mainly to **Europe, the USA, South America, and Australia** and can coordinate production
around **CE, FDA, UKCA, ISO, and BSCI** quality and compliance requirements. We also support
**custom logo printing** and private label packaging including cases, paper boxes, cleaning cloths,
and accessories. Visit our [About Us page][80], review the [sunglasses manufacturer page][81] and
[certification page][82], or [request a quote here][83].

medical device or just want to start selling your active pharmaceutical ingredients to Russian
partners, maybe you already realized that finding time-efficient, fully predictable and transparent
service provider, focused and dedicated to such projects in its experience would be optimal choice
for your business with long-term impact and perspective. Here are main reasons for how any service
solutions provided by us can be beneficial to your business in Russia and EAEU.

international industry standards. 100% of our experts have higher medical or pharmaceutical
education. Part of our staff have scientific degrees.

Our ethics principles fully correspond to high industry standards established in top international
companies. We are adherent to anticorruption legislation and measures. You can fully trust us on
highly turbulent and Russian regulatory sphere.

We guarantee quality at every stage of our work. Our rule is: if quality of service at any step is

## ABOUT US

We are Scary Beasties, a multi BAFTA award-winning digital creative agency dedicated to the design
and development of online, mobile and AR games. From a game’s initial concept, through to its
design, build and launch, our committed team of creatives and developers has been producing
market-leading digital solutions for our clients since 2007.

## MOBILE GAMES

Using the latest mobile technologies we develop 2D and 3D games for both Android and iOS to maximise
coverage of the smartphone and tablet markets.

## AUGMENTED REALITY

Mixing the real world with the digital, we create cutting edge mobile experiences that push the
boundaries of AR interactivity.

## ONLINE GAMES

From viral mini-games to immersive game-worlds, we tailor bespoke solutions in HTML5 to reach and
engage our clients’ target audiences.

#### RESEARCH  >  CONCEPT  >  DESIGN  >  BUILD  >  TEST  >  DELIVERY

[MORE NEWS][30]

##### LATEST FROM THE BEASTIES:

## [CLODS WALLUP GOES LIVE!][31]

[Scary Beasties brand new game, Clods Wallup, is out now. Avoid traps, work magic and steer clear of
the mouths of hungry Wallups as you guide your beloved Clods to safety over 144 fiendish
levels!][32]

[MORE NEWS][33]

##### LATEST FROM THE BEASTIES:

## [RICKY ZOOM NOMINATED FOR KIDSCREEN AWARD!][34]

[Scary Beasties is delighted that their Ricky Zoom: Welcome to Wheelford app, developed for
Entertainment One, has been nominated for a Kidscreen Award!][35]

[MORE NEWS][36]

##### LATEST FROM THE BEASTIES:

## [FROZEN 2 AR – AN ENCHANTED ADVENTURE!][37]

[Scary Beasties’ new Frozen 2 Augmented Reality app has launched! Collect portraits of your
favourite Frozen 2 friends, and find crystals to release magical powers, so you can be just like
Elsa!][38]

[MORE NEWS][39]

##### LATEST FROM THE BEASTIES:

## [EXPLORE A GALAXY FAR FAR AWAY WITH STAR WARS AR][40]

[Explore the Star Wars Galaxy with our free Star Wars Holoscanner Augmented Reality app. Become an
operative for the Resistance, pilot the Millennium Falcon, fight battle droids on Geonosis, control
an AT-ST in combat and much more.][41]

[MORE NEWS][42]

##### LATEST FROM THE BEASTIES:

## [LEARN TO CODE WITH PJ MASKS: HERO ACADEMY][43]

[Developed for Entertainment One][44][, Scary Beasties’ latest app “PJ Masks: Hero Academy” teaches
STEAM learning through the fundamentals of coding, with its fun and exciting gameplay, stories and
animated action!][45]

[MORE NEWS][46]

##### LATEST FROM THE BEASTIES:

## [TOYS COME TO LIFE WITH OUR TOY STORY AR APP][47]

[Scary Beasties’ new Toy Story Augmented Reality app has launched, bringing the Woody’s Augmented
Reality Adventure book to life. It’s an AR adventure to infinity… and beyond!][48]

[MORE NEWS][49]

##### LATEST FROM THE BEASTIES:

## [BEASTIES WIN KIDSCREEN LEARNING APP AWARD!][50]

[We are delighted to announce that our Hey Duggee: The Counting Badge app has won the Kidscreen Best
Branded Learning App award in the preschool category. Congratulations to all the team and massive
thanks to our development partners, Studio AKA and BBC Studios.][51]

[MORE NEWS][52]

##### LATEST FROM THE BEASTIES:

## [GHOSTKEEPER’S JOURNAL WINS FUTUREBOOK AWARD!][53]

[The Ghostkeeper’s Journal and Field Guide, one of Scary Beastie’s Augmented Reality app projects
for Carlton Books, has won the FutureBookLive FutureBook of the Year award! Congratulations to
Carlton and all the Scary Beasties team.][54]

[MORE NEWS][55]

##### LATEST FROM THE BEASTIES:

## [2ND BAFTA WIN FOR THE BEASTIES!][56]

[Our Hey Duggee: The Counting Badge app has taken home a 2018 Children’s BAFTA, winning in the
Digital category. Huge thanks to BBC Studios, Studio AKA and BAFTA – Duggee hugs all round!][57]

[MORE NEWS][58]

##### LATEST FROM THE BEASTIES:

## [NICKELODEON MUSIC LAB LAUNCHES!][59]

[Developed in HTML5 for Nickelodeon, Music Lab is a suite of games that allows you to collect the
essential components for making tunes and music videos: a memorable melody, cracking vocals, a
thumping beat, awesome sound effects and above all a great performance.][60]

[MORE NEWS][61]

## [JURASSIC WORLD AR – RAPTOR RESCUE!][62]

[Return to Jurassic World with our official Augmented Reality app for Universal Studios’ new
blockbuster movie Jurassic World: Fallen Kingdom. With all-new AR dinosaurs that will blow your
mind, this app accompaniment to the Carlton book is a must-have for every Jurassic World fan.][63]

[MORE NEWS][64]


## ABOUT US

We are Scary Beasties, a multi BAFTA award-winning digital creative agency dedicated to the design
and development of online, mobile and AR games. From a game’s initial concept, through to its
design, build and launch, our committed team of creatives and developers has been producing
market-leading digital solutions for our clients since 2007.

## MOBILE GAMES

Using the latest mobile technologies we develop 2D and 3D games for both Android and iOS to maximise
coverage of the smartphone and tablet markets.

## AUGMENTED REALITY

Mixing the real world with the digital, we create cutting edge mobile experiences that push the
boundaries of AR interactivity.

## ONLINE GAMES

From viral mini-games to immersive game-worlds, we tailor bespoke solutions in HTML5 to reach and
engage our clients’ target audiences.

# Google Search,
# totally
# reimagined
# with AI

It’s an AI Search that brings together our most advanced Gemini models, our newest agentic
capabilities and the world’s information.

## Announcements from Google I/O

### Meet the new intelligent Search box, reimagined with AI

It expands with your curiosity, offers AI powered suggestions and lets you search with text, videos
and more.

[ Introducing the new Search box ][17]
[Gemini 4 interface example]

### Stay updated on whatever matters most to you

Information agents in Search work 24/7, reasoning across data to find what you need and help you
take action.

[ More on information agents ][18]
[Multimodal reasoning interface]

### Shop across Google with one cart

Manage your shopping across Google and get intelligent insights with the new Universal Cart.

[ Learn more about agentic shopping ][19]

### Meet the new intelligent Search box, reimagined with AI

It expands with your curiosity, offers AI powered suggestions and lets you search with text, videos
and more.

[ Introducing the new Search box ][20]
[Gemini 4 interface example]

### Stay updated on whatever matters most to you

Information agents in Search work 24/7, reasoning across data to find what you need and help you
take action.

[ More on information agents ][21]
[Multimodal reasoning interface]

### Shop across Google with one cart

Manage your shopping across Google and get intelligent insights with the new Universal Cart.

[ Learn more about agentic shopping ][22]

## Frontier Model Capabilities in Search

[Agentic shopping interface]

### Gemini 3.5 Flash is here

We’ve upgraded AI Mode with Gemini 3.5 Flash for enhanced agentic coding capabilities and more
intelligent experiences.

[ Read more ][23]
[Latency benchmark preview]

### Get interactive visuals right in Search

For those complex topics, Search dynamically builds an interactive visual, in real-time, completely
customized for your specific question.

[ Learn about generative UI ][24]
[Aurora feature preview]

### Build custom experiences with Google Antigravity

Ask Search to build you dynamic tools, dashboards, or planners for long-running projects.

[ Get the latest on Antigravity in Search ][25]

### A seamless AI Search experience

It’s now simpler to continue the conversation with Search. Easily ask a follow-up question right
from an AI Overview, and flow into a conversational back and forth with AI Mode. [See how.][26]

### Personal Intelligence is expanding to more markets

Personal intelligence in Search is now available in nearly 200 countries, no subscription required.
[Opt in.][27]

### Get suggestions that are unique to your plans

Soon, you can connect your Google Calendar with Personal Intelligence to get suggestions that match
your schedule. [Read more.][28]

### Even more agentic booking capabilities

Ask Search to find exactly what you need, including checking for pricing and availability with
direct links to finish booking. Now across more tasks including local experiences and services.
[Learn more.][29]

### Easily check whether content was created or edited with gen AI tools

See [how image verification works][30]

### People are searching more than ever before. Last quarter, queries reached an all-time high

[Learn more][31]

[Sundar Pichai speaking at Google I/O]

## Ask anything that's on your mind

### AI Mode

Easily dig deeper and ask follow-up questions with our most powerful AI Search experience, where
you’ll find cutting edge features and capabilities

[ Explore more ][32]

### AI Overviews

Get a quick snapshot of key info about a topic or question with links to explore more on the web

[ Learn more ][33]

### Lens

Ask questions about what you see

[ Go deeper ][34]

### Search Live

Have a back-and-forth voice conversation with Search to get real-time help and quickly find relevant
sites across the web

[ Discover Search Live ][35]

### Digital Work Instructions, Checklists & SOPs

and enhancing overall productivity.
* Create precise, step-by-step digital work instructions to reduce errors and improve quality.

> When collaborating with overseas partners for technical intervention, there’s often a challenge

> This solution has proven to be outstanding for remote assistance services. The instant translation

> ensures seamless operation without encountering bugs. The quick response times and straightforward
> onboarding process make adopting it a hassle-free experience. Additionally, the unique features it
> provides truly set it apart, making it a reliable and efficient choice for businesses.

ET Eduard T. CEO, Food Production

> This solution is incredibly flexible and practical, making it an essential part of our workflow.
